doc.title: Toshiko Akiyoshi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And I really appreciate your joining me today.
Oh my pleasure. I had a great time talking, yeah.
Good. Well thank you so much, and best of success to you and I hope the charts keep flowing.
Not flowing, but I hope to be able to come up with something.
